description: Shared feature contract for the transaction fraud-risk model. Both the Python training pipeline (ml/train_fraud.py, gold.feature_fraud_orders) and the Go stream-score feature assembler (api/internal/scorewriter/features.go) must agree on exactly these names, in this order — it is the model's manifest feature order, which ml/serve.py uses to build the scoring DataFrame (missing features become 0.0). The file lives in the Go module because the Go side embeds it; the Python side reads it from disk and both test suites assert against it.

features.name: item_count
features.transform: count of order item rows (count(*), no quantity scaling)

features.name: payment_count
features.transform: count of payment rows on the order

features.name: installments_max
features.transform: max(payment_installments) over payment rows; 1 when none

features.name: categories_count
features.transform: distinct product categories in the order via gold.dim_products

features.name: price_vs_benchmark
features.transform: order_value / trailing-90-day mean order_value of the order's primary category (strictly-before window; 1.0 when no prior history)

features.name: velocity_24h
features.transform: same-customer order count with event-time at or after t-24h, excluding this order

features.name: account_age_days
features.transform: whole days (floor) between the customer's first processed order and this order (event-time)

features.name: is_weekend
features.transform: 1 when the purchase timestamp isodow is 6 or 7

features.name: pay_boleto
features.transform: one-hot of the primary payment type (row with max payment_value); 1 when boleto

features.name: pay_credit_card
features.transform: one-hot of the primary payment type; 1 when credit_card

features.name: pay_debit_card
features.transform: one-hot of the primary payment type; 1 when debit_card

features.name: pay_not_defined
features.transform: one-hot of the primary payment type; 1 when not_defined

features.name: pay_unknown
features.transform: one-hot; 1 when the order has no payment rows (fillna 'unknown')

features.name: pay_voucher
features.transform: one-hot of the primary payment type; 1 when voucher

features.name: category_code
features.transform: revenue-rank code of the top-price item's category via registry metrics.category_rank (never recomputed here)
